description: Find dangling DNS records and subdomain-takeover setups, plus CAA and DNSSEC checks, via DoH
notes: Requires Python 3 on PATH (python.org installer with .py file association, or `scoop install python`). Run: dns-hygiene-checker --help. Changelog: https://github.com/CanuteTheGreat/dns-hygiene-checker/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
